dct_title_s: Boulder Lake Reservoir NE Quadrangle, Minnesota-St. Louis County, 1957: 7.5 Minute Series (Topographic) Map
dct_description_sm: Boulder Lake Reservoir NE quadrangle topographic map (N4707.5-W9200/7.5) featuring handwritten notations by Ray Segar in red ink and pencil regarding logging railroad lines and camps in the area south of Markham. The hand written notations include information on the following: Duluth, Northeastern Railroad (DNE) line.
